name: progress-ring
title: Progress Ring
description: A determinate ring that eases to its value and counts up in the middle.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the progress bar.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Shows the percentage in the middle when no children are given.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds the ring takes to catch up with a new value.

props.name: children
props.description: Replaces the percentage in the middle.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
